note: Machine-readable compatibility ledger: every compatibility scenario is tracked as pass / known-gap / not-applicable under a permanent hc-<suite>-<capability>-<case> id. Status, reason and recordedAt semantics follow ADR-0002 section 7; the ledger was established by T11 and absorbed the T09 known-gap records (tests/compat/types/expected-divergences.json).

entries.reason: MAD DOM is in pre-alpha development and createWindow() throws during scenario setup with Error("mad-dom is in pre-alpha development and does not implement Window yet."), so the mad-dom side records no window, no appended node and no serialization output while the happy-dom side records the full observation. First presented by the T10 real-pair runner; collected into the compatibility ledger by T11.

Same setup-phase createWindow() throw as the pre-alpha facade gap: querySelectorAll results, element identity across repeated queries and click bubbling order are observable only on the happy-dom side. First presented by the T10 real-pair runner; collected into the compatibility ledger by T11.

MAD DOM does not export Window, CSSRule or EventPhaseEnum yet; enum members and tag-name overload shapes cannot be checked. First recorded in T09 as div-types-enums-and-overloads; migrated into the compatibility ledger by T11.

Module-level gap: MAD DOM does not export Window, so the negative marked lines currently fall through as unused @ts-expect-error directives (TS2578) on the mad-dom target. Recorded per ADR-0002 section 4 instead of forcing a pass; once the import resolves, the marked lines must genuinely error on mad-dom. First recorded in T09 as div-types-negative-invalid-members; migrated into the compatibility ledger by T11.

MAD DOM does not export Window, Event or EventPhaseEnum yet; the addEventListener callback parameter degrades to implicit any (TS7006) while the module-level gap exists. First recorded in T09 as div-types-event-callbacks; migrated into the compatibility ledger by T11.

MAD DOM does not export CustomEvent or Window yet; both constructor usages are rejected via the missing imports. First recorded in T09 as div-types-constructor-options; migrated into the compatibility ledger by T11.

MAD DOM does not export the Event value or the IEventInit/TEventListener type exports; annotations that reference them degrade to implicit any (TS7006) while the module-level gap exists. First recorded in T09 as div-types-type-exports; migrated into the compatibility ledger by T11.

MAD DOM does not export Window yet; the whole fixture degrades because the Window value import is missing (pre-alpha type surface). First recorded in T09 as div-types-window-document-basics; migrated into the compatibility ledger by T11.
